# Retired Meta DSL provenance

This tree preserves reviewed Unica-owned adaptations of donor `meta-compile`,
`meta-edit`, and `meta-validate` artifacts solely as historical provenance.
Nothing under this directory is packaged, prompt-visible, loaded by MCP, or
selected by the script-parity execution harness. Current behavior is owned by
the typed `unica.meta.add`, `unica.meta.edit`, `unica.meta.info`, and
`unica.meta.remove` contracts and the internal metadata validator.
